text: Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: Option b, 18.0 s to 18.8 s. From above, brown floodwater spreads left to right along the street until it covers the full width by 18.8 s, with the white car roof sitting in it at left-center. The caption band sits over the lower pair of roofs. Roofs remain flat black-and-gray triangle squares.
